title: Spanish-Style Corn Fritters
description: Crispy and flavorful, these gluten-free corn fritters are a delicious twist on traditional cornbread.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together cornmeal, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper.
In a separate bowl, whisk together light, egg, and a pinch of salt.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until combined.
Heat about 1 inch of oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter into the oil.
Fry the fritters for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Drain the fritters on paper towels.
Serve warm with your favorite dipping sauce.
